youtube_short.title: Your Fund Lost Money — IRS Still Wants $3,200
title_alternatives: The Mutual Fund Tax Trap Nobody Warns You About
Why Your Fund Loss Still Triggers an IRS Bill
youtube_short.description: Most investors have no idea their mutual fund can create a taxable event even when it loses money. It's called a capital gains distribution — the fund manager's trades inside the fund get passed to you as a tax bill every December. In 2022, the average mutual fund distributed 8.3% of its value while markets were down. On a $100K portfolio that's $8,300 in surprise taxable income. The fix? ETFs. Same stocks, near-zero distributions. Check your brokerage account and switch — it takes five minutes. #personalfinance #investing #mutualfunds #etf #taxstrategy #moneytips
